fresh_primary_sources.finding: GUI-specific KV-cache compression exploits spatial saliency and temporal redundancy across screenshots and can preserve or improve accuracy at reduced decode cost.

GUI KV importance is subspace- and trajectory-dependent; adaptive spatio-temporal reweighting outperforms fixed/shared cache selection at matched budgets and materially reduces peak memory in the reported setups.

distinction: Native/model-side KV-cache compression preserves decoder history representations. PBC-VEC stores bounded owned perceptual descriptors/evidence identities outside truth/effect authority and is intended to decide whether a new deep encode/decode is needed. These mechanisms may be complementary, redundant or interfere; literature cannot decide this for the target runtime.
new_counterhypothesis: Once a strong native GUI-aware KV cache policy is enabled, VEC provides negligible additional end-to-end benefit and only adds stale-version/alias complexity.

test_obligation.pass_rule: VEC survives as an architecture candidate only if it is Pareto-additive or uniquely improves early perceptual bypass/reuse under exact version controls; if strong native GUI-aware KV caching dominates, VEC is simplified or removed.
